title: 学習・発達論
subtitle: Learning and Development
educationalGoal: Learning Psychology and Developmental Psychology help us to practice effective education. In this course, students will understand learning theory, developmental theory and developmental disorder. After understanding them, students will acquire practical skills and perspectives.
advice:
This course aims to acquire basics of Leaning Psychology and Developmental Psychology for junior and senior high school teachers. They include the following materials:

 1. Development: cognitive development, personality development, development of sociality, developmental disorder
 2. Lerning: lerning theory, motivation, teaching-learning theory

Students will take lectures and discuss their significance with other students.
Students are required to actively participate in class.
Students are expected to be interested in the current state of school.
Students are expected to apply theories to educational practice.
Students are expected to build their own view of education.
books: Essentials of Educational Psychology(2nd ed.), Nakanishiya Shuppan
requiredKnowledge: To have taken the course of “Educational Psyhology”

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain basic developmental theories.
Be able to answer the space filling and descriptive questions about developmental theories.
Be able to answer the space filling and descriptive questions about learning theories.
Be able to understand developmental disorder students and describe the views how to support them.
Be able to describe ideas about effective education from the perspective of learning.
Engage in this course and self-evaluate objectives of this course to be achieved.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Understand important theories in developmental psychology and explain them.

(2) Understand basic teaching-learning theories and explain how to apply to educational activities.

(3) Understand the basics about developmental disorder and explain how to teach school students with the disorder.

(4) Understand the basics about motivation and explain how to enhance school students’ motivation.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1)  Understand important theories in developmental psychology.

(2) Understand basic teaching-learning theories

(3) Understand the basics about developmental disorder.

(4) Understand the basics about motivation and its significance in education.
